GmailThreadSummary.description:
A Gmail thread summary, as returned by `users.threads.list`.

A summary carries the thread metadata without its messages; fetch
the full [`GmailThread`] with `users.threads.get`.

historyId.description: Id of the last history record that modified the thread.

snippet.description: Short part of the message text.

description:
A listing plus the cursor of its next page.

The cursor is part of the output, a footer line in text and a
`next_page` field in JSON, so a script reads it. Logging it to stderr
would not.
title: Paginated
